plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% and CRWD to 10% to reduce concentration and increase cash.

conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and concentration, holding a larger cash buffer for stability.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 25% and CRWD to 10% to lower concentration.

This plan balances risk reduction with continued growth potential.
balanced.read: This plan targets around 2.5% per month by balancing risk reduction with growth. It trims concentrated positions and leveraged ETFs while adding a quality name, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL to 6% each, increasing leveraged ETF exposure.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, accepting higher potential drawdowns. It increases leveraged ETF exposure and concentrates on high-scoring setups, with a smaller cash buffer. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can impact returns.

plan: Sell all SOXL, SPAL, and CRWD to exit high-beta and leveraged positions.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash.
Add QQQ to 15% for broad market exposure and stability.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It shifts heavily into income-generating assets like QQQI, reducing leverage and high-beta single names. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall.
